title: Growth Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Rund 74 % aller CO₂-Emissionen in Deutschland entstehen im Zusammenhang mit der Energieproduktion, das sind über 543 Millionen Tonnen pro Jahr.

Um die europäischen Klimaziele zu erreichen, müssen wir dieses Problem dringend und entschlossen angehen, und genau hier setzen wir bei Sunpeak Capital an.

Wir machen den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien investierbar und verwandeln Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur in renditestarke Investments. Unser Ansatz verbindet Klimaschutz mit finanzieller Intelligenz: ein echtes Win-Win für Umwelt und Investoren.

Mit unserer Kombination aus spezialisierten Beratungsprozessen, innovativen Investmentstrukturen und einem breiten Netzwerk aus Projektentwicklern ermöglichen wir privaten und unternehmerischen Investoren, den Energiewandel aktiv mitzugestalten, profitabel und nachhaltig.

Wir skalieren unser Modell konsequent innerhalb Deutschlands, dort, wo die Energiewende entschieden wird. Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage dazu bei, dass Kapitalströme dorthin fließen, wo sie größten Klimanutzen und echte Rendite erzeugen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du übernimmst unser Marketing von den Gründern und baust es weiter aus. Einiges läuft bereits, vieles existiert noch nicht. Dein Job ist es, daraus eine Growth-Maschine zu machen: Du verantwortest Lead-Volumen, Lead-Qualität und Akquisitionskosten, testest den Funnel konsequent durch und entscheidest, welche Kanäle wie viel Budget bekommen. Wir suchen keine Person, die Briefings abarbeitet und auch keinen reinen Creative, sondern jemanden mit Performance-Mindset, der Kanäle versteht, Tests selbst aufsetzt und das Thema Growth bei Sunpeak Capital zu 100 % eigenverantwortlich ownt.

  • Growth-Strategie und Budget: Du entwickelst mit den Gründern den Marketing-Plan, definierst Zielgruppen, Kanäle, Budgets und KPIs und steuerst Soll gegen Ist.

  • Performance-Marketing: Unsere bezahlten Kampagnen liegen komplett bei dir. Du skalierst, was funktioniert, testest laufend neue Kampagnen und Zielgruppen und optimierst auf Lead-Qualität, nicht nur auf Volumen. Neue Kanäle testest du an, wenn die Zahlen es hergeben.

  • Funnel und Conversion: Du baust und testest Landingpages und Funnels, optimierst Qualifizierung, Formulare und On-Page Conversion und sorgst dafür, dass Anzeige, Botschaft und Landingpage zusammenpassen.

  • SEO und Content: Du steuerst Agentur, Freelancer und Gastautoren, planst Themen und Ratgeberartikel und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Inhalte technisch und inhaltlich sauber ranken. Longform-Content denkst du von Anfang an so, dass daraus Shorts, Reels und Ads entstehen.

  • Creatives: Du konzipierst Ads, Hooks und Skripte und drehst einfache Formate mit unseren Gründern. Schnitt und Postproduktion laufen AI-gestützt oder über Freelancer. Du musst kein Videoprofi sein, aber ein gutes Auge für das haben, was in Ads performt.

  • Newsletter und Lead Nurturing: Unser E-Mail-Marketing läuft bereits. Du entwickelst Segmentierung, Automationen und Inhalte entlang der gesamten Investor Journey weiter, inklusive Reaktivierung bestehender Leads.

  • Daten und Tracking: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CRM (HubSpot) und unserem Marketing-Dashboard, hältst das Tracking sauber und machst sichtbar, welche Maßnahmen tatsächlich Investoren bringen.

  • Brand: Du ziehst unsere Brand konsequent durch alle Touchpoints, von Ads über Social Media bis zu Investorenmaterialien.

  • AI-First: Du arbeitest AI-first, bei Creatives, Schnitt, Artikeln, Reporting und Automatisierung. Was manuell nicht sein muss, wird es bei dir auch nicht. Das Budget für die passenden Tools stellen wir, welche das sind, entscheidest du.

  • Perspektive: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und bist von Tag eins für die Zahlen verantwortlich. Mit wachsendem Erfolg steuerst du dein eigenes Team an Freelancern, Agenturen und Werkstudenten.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance- oder Growth-Marketing in einem Startup oder Scale-up und einen Proven Track Record: Kampagnen, Kanäle oder Funnels, die du messbar aufgebaut oder skaliert hast

  • Du bist hands-on in Paid Social und Paid Search und hast Erfahrung mit Landingpage- und Funnel-Testing. SEO und E-Mail-Marketing kennst du gut genug, um Agenturen und Freelancer zu steuern

  • Du denkst in Funnel-Kennzahlen: CPL, CTR, Conversion Rate und Lead-Qualität sind für dich Werkzeuge, keine Buzzwords. Du setzt Tests sauber auf, wertest sie aus und ziehst Konsequenzen

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Hooks, Creatives und Storytelling und weißt, was auf Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn und Instagram funktioniert. Eigene Erfahrung mit Kamera und Schnitt ist ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung

  • Du arbeitest dich sehr schnell tief in erneuerbare Energien, Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und die steuerliche Logik unserer Investments ein. Nur wer das Produkt versteht, kann dafür Marketing machen, das Investoren überzeugt

  • Du arbeitest AI-first: AI-Tools sind für dich in Content-Produktion, Auswertung und Automatisierung fester Teil des Workflows

  • Du arbeitest mit hoher Autonomie, triffst Entscheidungen selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, auch wenn es unbequem wird

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ein sicheres Gespür für Sprache und Tonalität

  • Du bist verfügbar für eine Vollzeitstelle und bereit, an 5 Tagen pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro zu arbeiten

  • Bonus: Erfahrung im Marketing für Finanz- oder Investmentprodukte oder in erneuerbaren Energien, oder du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera

Benefits

  • Ownership und Impact: Du baust das Marketing von Sunpeak Capital von Anfang an mit auf, arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und hast prägenden Einfluss darauf, wie wir am Markt wahrgenommen werden

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Top Leistung wird bei uns auch adäquat bezahlt!

  • Kostenfreie Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft: Power dich nach der Arbeit aus beim Sport.

  • Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte: Kaffee in Barista-Qualität, Designer-Möbel und technisches Top-Setup (Apple Hardware + XXL Screens).

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events: Gemeinsame Team Abende und unser jährliches Offsite stärken das Miteinander und machen die Zeit bei uns noch besser.

  • Workation: Anfang 2027 reisen wir gemeinsam für 2 Wochen nach Kapstadt.

Über uns

Sunpeak Capital entstand aus der gemeinsamen Vision von Konstantin und Jan. Vor der Gründung waren sie die ersten beiden Mitarbeiter des Fintech-Scale-ups Cloover, welches PV-Anlagen finanziert. Für dieses bauten sie den deutschen Markt auf und skalierten und das Partnernetzwerk auf über 200 Installationsbetriebe. In dieser Zeit erkannten sie, welches Potenzial entsteht, wenn man Kapital gezielt in nachhaltige Energieprojekte lenkt.

Anfang 2025 gründeten sie dann Sunpeak Capital - vollständig gebootstrapped und bereits nach zwei Monaten profitabel. Ihr Antrieb: die Mechanismen des Kapitalmarkts nutzen, um den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien zu beschleunigen und Investoren echte Rendite mit echtem Impact zu ermöglichen.

title: Content Creator / Videograf (m/w/d) – Fußball & Vereinsleben | deutschlandweit
description:
Werkstudententätigkeit, Nebenjob, freie Mitarbeit oder Festanstellung

Zeig die Geschichten hinter unseren Stickeralben

Eine Mannschaft hält zum ersten Mal ihr eigenes Stickeralbum in den Händen. Kinder entdecken sich auf einem Sticker. Am Spielfeldrand wird getauscht, gesammelt und diskutiert, wer noch fehlt. Genau diese Momente möchten wir zeigen.

Wir bei stickerfive entwickeln und produzieren individuelle Stickeralben für den Amateur- und Profisport sowie für Unternehmen und besondere Themenwelten. Für unsere Videos und Social-Media-Inhalte suchen wir Menschen, die solche Geschichten erkennen und mit der Kamera erzählen können.

Dabei möchten wir mit mehreren Creatorn in verschiedenen Regionen Deutschlands zusammenarbeiten. Vielleicht begleitest Du einzelne Projekte in Deiner Nähe. Vielleicht suchst Du einen regelmäßigen Nebenjob, eine Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine Festanstellung mit größerem Aufgabenbereich. Schreib uns, was zu Dir passt.

Das kannst Du bei uns machen

  • Vereine begleiten: Du besuchst Fotoshootings, Kick-Offs, Verkaufsstarts und Tauschbörsen und fängst die Stimmung vor Ort ein.

  • Content aufnehmen und produzieren: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Ideen für Reels, TikToks und Stories und drehst das passende Material. Wenn Du selbst schneidest, kannst Du fertige Videos liefern. Genauso ist es möglich, uns Deine Aufnahmen zu übergeben, damit unser internes Team Schnitt und Veröffentlichung übernimmt.

  • Menschen zu Wort kommen lassen: Du führst kurze Interviews mit Vereinsmitgliedern, Fans und Verantwortlichen und zeigst, was die Sammelaktion für sie bedeutet.

  • Eigene Formate entwickeln: Ob erste Reaktionen auf die Sticker, Einblicke hinter die Kulissen oder Geschichten aus dem Vereinsleben: Deine Ideen sind gefragt.

  • Projekte eigenständig vorbereiten: Du stimmst Termine und Inhalte mit unserem Team und den Vereinen ab und sorgst dafür, dass aus dem Dreh veröffentlichungsfähiges Material wird.

  • Drehs und Inhalte organisieren: Du stimmst Dich mit unseren Vereinen sowie mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb ab. Du planst Termine und kümmerst Dich rechtzeitig um die Informationen und Materialien, die Du benötigst.

Was du mitbringst

Du hast bereits Videos oder Social-Media-Inhalte erstellt und kannst uns Beispiele zeigen. Ob für ein Unternehmen, einen Verein, Deinen eigenen Kanal oder ein privates Projekt, ist dabei zweitrangig. Uns interessiert, was Du selbst umgesetzt hast.

Außerdem wünschen wir uns:

  • Einen sicheren Umgang mit Smartphone oder Kamera.

  • Ein Gespür für spannende Momente, gute Bildausschnitte und Geschichten aus dem Vereinsleben.

  • Interesse am Sport sowie Freude daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen.

  • Zuverlässigkeit bei Absprachen, Terminen und der Übergabe Deiner Aufnahmen.

  • Bereitschaft zu Drehs vor Ort, je nach Veranstaltung, meistens am Wochenende.

Videoschnitt ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wenn Du mit CapCut, Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve arbeitest, kannst Du Deine Aufnahmen selbst schneiden. Du kannst uns aber auch das aufgenommene Material übergeben. Schnitt und Veröffentlichung übernimmt dann unser internes Team.

Eine bestimmte Ausbildung, ein Studium oder eine große eigene Followerschaft setzen wir nicht voraus. Erfahrung mit Werbeanzeigen oder Performance Marketing brauchst Du für diese Rolle ebenfalls nicht.

So kann unsere Zusammenarbeit aussehen

Wir suchen deutschlandweit und möchten ein Netzwerk aus Creatorn aufbauen, die unsere Projekte in ihrer jeweiligen Region begleiten. Du musst deshalb nicht in der Nähe unseres Büros in Gräfelfing bei München wohnen.

Je nach Deiner Verfügbarkeit und unserem Bedarf kommen unterschiedliche Formen der Zusammenarbeit infrage:

  • Freie Mitarbeit: Du übernimmst einzelne Drehs oder Projekte auf Honorarbasis.

  • Nebenjob oder Minijob: Du unterstützt uns regelmäßig mit einem überschaubaren Stundenumfang.

  • Werkstudententätigkeit: Du sammelst neben Deinem Studium praktische Erfahrung in der Content-Produktion.

  • Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: Du begleitest regelmäßig unsere Projekte und entwickelst Inhalte und Formate gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.

Welche Aufgaben Du übernimmst und welcher Umfang passt, besprechen wir gemeinsam. Auch wenn Du zunächst nur einzelne Einsätze übernehmen möchtest, kannst Du Dich melden.

Die Drehs finden bei unseren Partnervereinen statt. Vorbereitung und gegebenenfalls Schnitt können nach Absprache von zu Hause erfolgen. Vor jedem Einsatz klären wir, welche Aufnahmen wir benötigen und ob Du Rohmaterial oder fertig geschnittene Videos lieferst.

Was Dich erwartet

Du bekommst Zugang zu Geschichten aus dem Amateur- und Profisport und kannst eigene Ideen direkt umsetzen. Unser Team unterstützt Dich bei der Abstimmung mit den Vereinen und stellt Dir die nötigen Informationen zu den Projekten bereit.

Vergütung, Ausstattung und mögliche Reisekosten klären wir passend zur jeweiligen Zusammenarbeit vorab. Bei regelmäßigen Einsätzen planen wir gemeinsam, welche Termine mit Deinem Studium, Hauptjob oder anderen Projekten vereinbar sind.

Zeig uns, was Du machst

Schick uns einen kurzen Überblick über Dich und ein paar Arbeitsproben. Besonders interessieren uns Videos oder Aufnahmen, die Du selbst gemacht hast. Sie müssen nicht fertig geschnitten sein. Bei gemeinsamen Produktionen schreib bitte dazu, welchen Teil Du übernommen hast.

Sag uns außerdem:

  • Wo Du wohnst und in welcher Region Du Drehs übernehmen kannst.

  • Welche Form der Zusammenarbeit und welchen zeitlichen Umfang Du suchst.

  • Ob Du Deine Aufnahmen auch selbst schneiden möchtest.

  • Ob Du lieber hinter der Kamera arbeitest oder auch selbst davor stehen möchtest.

  • Wann Du starten könntest und welche Vergütung Du Dir vorstellst.

Bewirb Dich direkt hier über die Plattform. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Arbeiten und darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The opportunity

How taxation, accounting and payroll work today is a pain for everyone. Still every business must do it continuously. It is the backbone our economy runs on.

Enabled through AI, we are turning this often-painful process into a radically simple experience for our customers, so they can focus on what matters to them: growing their business.

The role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you own a product area – e.g. bookkeeping, payroll or client onboarding – and take it from problem to production. You work directly with the founders, product and our tax experts, and you decide how things get built in your area.

We are past the founding phase but still very early: most of what you touch is greenfield.

What you’ll own

  • Your product area, end-to-end: Turn customer and tax-expert problems into shipped features (spec → ship → measure).
  • APIs, data models and services: Design and build the backend your area runs on – and ship the UI on top.
  • AI that is correct, not just plausible: Build AI-powered workflows with evaluation, fallbacks and human review where it matters.
  • Quality and operations: Tests, monitoring and incident response for what you ship.
  • Raising the bar: Code reviews, mentoring, and active part in hiring engineers.

Our tech context (greenfield)

  • Prefer boring tech where it matters; innovate where it differentiates.
  • Current stack (continually evolving): TypeScript end-to-end, Next.js (React) with server-side APIs, PostgreSQL, Vercel, …
  • Most hard problems sit behind the API: data modelling for tax logic, third-party integrations, and AI pipelines.
  • Tooling budget for whatever makes you fast. No legacy, no yak-shaving.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years building and operating web applications in production, end-to-end
  • Strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals; React on the frontend (Next.js or comparable)
  • Backend depth: API design, relational data modelling (PostgreSQL), third-party integrations
  • A track record of owning features from idea to production with real users
  • Product mindset: you talk to users, challenge requirements and cut scope to ship
  • AI deeply integrated into your daily engineering work – beyond autocompletion
  • Experience with containerised deployments (e.g. Docker) and CI/CD
  • A degree in computer science or a related field – or an equivalent track record
  • Very good English (min. C1); German is a plus
  • A valid work permit for Germany and readiness to work on-site in Munich

Nice to have

  • LLM-based features in production (RAG, agents, evaluations)
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up
  • Exposure to fintech, accounting, tax or payroll

The process (fast, meaningful, no homework)

  • Intro call with a recruiter
  • Get to know a fellow engineer, virtually or in person (up to you)
  • Meet our founding team in a final interview (in person, ~3h, incl. live coding)

title: First Level IT-Support / Kundenberatung (m/w/d)
description:
Support-Hero & Problemlöser gesucht – Quereinstieg willkommen!

Du hilfst einfach gerne anderen Menschen? Du tüftelst gerne an technischen Herausforderungen, bis sie gelöst sind? Dann passt du perfekt in unser Team!

Als gewachsenes Tech-Unternehmen ist WIRECLOUD ein führender Anbieter von Cloud-Telefonanlagen. Wir suchen Verstärkung für unseren IT-Support, die Lust hat, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Dabei zählt für uns vor allem deine Einstellung und deine Motivation, anzupacken. Neben dem Kundensupport gehört auch die Bearbeitung von Behördenanfragen zu deinen Aufgaben.

Dein Start bei uns

Wir lassen dich nicht allein. Du bekommst ein strukturiertes Onboarding, bei dem du unser Team, die Systeme und die Welt der Cloud-Telefonie kennenlernst. Wir führen dich Schritt für Schritt an deine Aufgaben heran, und dein Aufgabenfeld entwickelt sich mit deinem Know-how ganz natürlich weiter.

Deine Mission

  • First Level Support: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Bestandskunden bei Fragen rund um ihre Telefonanlage per Telefon und E-Mail (kein Sales!).

  • Probleme lösen: Du hörst zu, analysierst technische Anliegen und hilfst dem Kunden geduldig weiter.

  • Behördenanfragen: Du bearbeitest und dokumentierst eingehende Anfragen von Behörden nach klar geregelten Abläufen.

Dein Profil

Quereinsteiger sind bei uns ausdrücklich willkommen. Ein technischer Hintergrund ist ideal, aber kein Muss. Wichtig ist uns:

  • Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt: Du hast schon im Support, in der Kundenberatung, im Service oder in einem anderen Job mit viel Menschenkontakt gearbeitet. Telefonieren ist für dich selbstverständlich, und du bleibst auch dann freundlich und geduldig, wenn es mal hakt.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift: Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische Unternehmen aus Deutschland. Du erklärst ihnen technische Themen am Telefon und per E-Mail sicher und verständlich.

  • Mittwochs in Köln: Wir arbeiten überwiegend im Homeoffice. Mittwochs kommt das ganze Team im Büro in Köln zusammen, und dieser Bürotag ist fester Bestandteil der Stelle. Eine reine Remote-Stelle können wir leider nicht anbieten.

Deine Benefits

Interesse an einem Kennenlernen?

Wir sind ein kleiner, familiärer Betrieb und haben keine Lust auf steife Standard-Anschreiben – die sagen uns meistens sowieso nichts über dich aus. Wir möchten einfach wissen, wer du bist.

title: Vice President Finance (all genders)
description:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As Vice President Finance (all genders), you will lead and further professionalise our global Finance function, ensuring the company has the financial transparency, processes, and steering mechanisms required to scale successfully.

This role combines strategic financial leadership with hands-on ownership of all core finance activities, including financial planning, controlling, accounting, treasury, payroll, tax, reporting, and finance operations. You will lead a growing team and continue the transformation of Finance from a scale-up function into a mature, globally operating business partner.

Beyond running the existing function, you will proactively identify future challenges and opportunities, helping leadership make well-informed decisions through robust planning, forecasting, business insights, and financial modeling. You will act as a trusted partner to the C-Level and leadership, and our corporate shareholder, ensuring Finance is not only a reporting function but a strategic driver of long-term success.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1-2 days per week working from our Berlin office.

Your Mission

Financial Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, develop, and inspire the Finance team across all functional areas.
  • Manage and support direct reports, including Accounting, Controlling, and Finance Operations.
  • Build organisational capabilities, processes, and structures required for the next stage of growth.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on ownership, accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure appropriate resource planning and team development.

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Own the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes from a financial perspective.
  • Develop scalable planning structures and financial governance frameworks across all departments.
  • Ensure financial targets are translated into operational plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Continuously improve forecast quality and business visibility.
  • Support leadership with scenario planning and strategic decision-making.

Controlling & Business Partnering

  • Further develop financial controlling processes and management reporting.
  • Partner with department leaders to improve financial planning, cost transparency, and performance management.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify risks early, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Establish a culture of financial accountability throughout the organisation.
  • Drive improvements in cost tracking, resource planning, and investment prioritisation.

Financial Reporting & Accounting

  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting across all entities and markets.
  • Oversee accounting, payroll, tax, treasury, and financial operations.
  • Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and internal reporting requirements.
  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes.
  • Coordinate external audits and relevant financial reviews.

Corporate & Shareholder Finance

  • Serve as the primary financial interface to our corporate shareholder and relevant stakeholders.
  • Prepare board and shareholder reporting materials.
  • Support capital planning and long-term financial strategy.
  • Ensure transparency and professionalism in all financial communications.

Global Finance Operations

  • Own Finance processes across all markets.
  • Ensure consistency of financial standards and reporting across countries.
  • Support international expansion through scalable financial structures and processes.
  • Promote best-practice sharing and operational alignment across markets.

Finance Systems, Data & Automation

  • Drive the professionalisation and automation of Finance processes.
  • Improve the quality, availability, and utilisation of financial data.
  • Define requirements for Finance tooling, reporting, and workflow improvements.
  • Collaborate with Strategic Operations, Data, Product, and Engineering teams on automation initiatives.
  • Leverage technology and AI-enabled solutions to increase efficiency and decision quality.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously evaluate and improve Finance processes, controls, and governance structures with a strong focus on simplicity and ease of use.
  • Reduce manual effort through standardisation and automation.
  • Implement scalable operating models that support company growth.
  • Ensure Finance remains fit for purpose as organisational complexity increases.

Requirements

What You Need to Succeed

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience in at least 2-3 of the following areas: Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Accounting, or related fields.
  • Proven leadership experience in a successful start-up, scale-up, or top-tier environment.
  • Strong background in financial planning, forecasting, and business partnering.
  • Experience in building and professionalising finance functions and processes.
  • Exposure to corporate structures and shareholder reporting environments.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, technology, or other regulated industries is beneficial.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Outstanding financial planning and modelling skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-making at leadership level.
  • High degree of ownership and proactiveness.
  • Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Strong understanding of finance systems, reporting structures, and process design.
  • Interest in automation, AI, and technology-enabled finance processes.

Languages:

  • Full professional fluency (written and spoken) in English and German

Benefits

Why getolo?

🌴 Salary & Vacation

  • Attractive fixed salary
  • Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st.

🧑‍💻 Mobility & Flexibility

  • Choose between a free Swapfiets bike, or a Berlin/Brandenburg ticket (“VBB - Jobticket”) or BVG “Deutschlandticket” subsidized by us
  • Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte
  • Work abroad in the EU for up to 60 days

🧘 Health

  • Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool
  • Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo

📚 Development

  • Learning Budget starting from 750 € per year
  • Regular (360 degree) feedback

🌍 Berlin Based, International Mindset

  • We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included
  • Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries

🧬 Values

  • Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA:

  • #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes

  • #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction

  • #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions

  • #caring: We treat each other with respect, build trust, and create an environment where everyone can thrive

🙌 And much more…

  • Legendary summer and winter parties
  • Regular team events
  • Many discounts on the corporate Benefits Platform
  • Two Community Days per calendar year
  • Pet friendly office

Sounds like the perfect job for you? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

About getolo

Founded in 2015, getolo GmbH is an innovative and award-winning InsurTech company that offers comprehensive supplementary insurance plans in the areas of dental, pet health and liability, as well as health add-on coverage. Under the brands dentolo, petolo, patolo and vitolo, we serve over 265,000 customers across Germany, France and Spain, providing digital and hassle-free protection that seamlessly integrates into their daily lives.
We believe that prevention is always better than cure—which is why we focus on preventive care, customer-centric service, and financial security to protect our customers and their loved ones from unexpected costs. Thanks to the close collaboration of our team of market specialists and insurance experts, we continuously monitor industry developments to offer practical solutions for current challenges.
getolo's company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and agility—always with a strong focus on the needs of our customers. With a team of around 300 employees, getolo is led by Daniel Gadea (CEO) and Laura Wulff (CGO). getolo is a partner of DA Direkt and part of the Zurich Group Germany.

getolo is an equal opportunity and diversity employer. We strive to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all our team members, regardless of ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, limitations and talents of any kind, physical appearance, social background, marital status, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

When you apply, we focus solely on your experience and motivation. You decide what additional information you want to disclose (photo, marital status, religion, gender, nationality, etc.). We value and treat all applications equally.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
The opportunity

How taxation, accounting and payroll work today is a pain for everyone. Still every business must do it continuously. It is the backbone our economy runs on.

Enabled through AI, we are turning this often-painful process into a radically simple experience for our customers, so they can focus on what matters to them: growing their business.

The role

As a Staff Software Engineer, you are the technical counterpart to our founders. You look beyond a single product area: you shape the architecture across the platform, make the decisions that are expensive to reverse, and make sure we scale from one country to many without rewriting the core.

You stay hands-on and write a lot of code – but your impact is measured by what the whole engineering team ships.

What you’ll own

  • Technical direction: Define architecture and tech strategy across the platform; write and drive RFCs for the decisions that matter.
  • Core systems: Own the foundations every product area builds on – the domain model for tax and accounting logic and the integration layer to third-party systems.
  • AI correctness at scale: Set the standards for how we build, evaluate and monitor AI pipelines that have to be correct, not just plausible.
  • Scale and reliability: Prepare the platform for more countries, more customers and higher compliance demands – security, auditability, observability.
  • Engineering bar: Shape how we build – review standards, tooling, delivery practices; mentor senior engineers and own the technical hiring bar.
  • Partner to the founders: Translate business strategy into a technical roadmap and spot where technology creates leverage.

Our tech context (greenfield)

Prefer boring tech where it matters; innovate where it differentiates.

Current stack (continually evolving): TypeScript end-to-end, Next.js (React) with server-side APIs, PostgreSQL, Vercel, …

Most hard problems sit behind the API: data modelling for tax logic, third-party integrations, and AI pipelines.

You will decide how this stack evolves as we scale.

What you’ll bring

  • 8+ years building and operating production systems, including several years in a technical leadership role (Staff, Lead, Principal or equivalent)
  • A track record of designing and evolving the architecture of a product that scaled – in users, data and team size
  • Deep backend expertise: data modelling, API design, distributed systems, integrations; strong TypeScript/Node (or the depth to get there fast)
  • Influence without authority: you have led technical decisions across team boundaries, with clear written design docs
  • Experience making product and business trade-offs together with founders or senior leadership
  • You have mentored senior engineers and shaped hiring
  • AI deeply integrated into your daily engineering work, plus experience shipping LLM-based features to production
  • A degree in computer science or a related field – or an equivalent track record
  • Very good English (min. C1); German is a plus
  • A valid work permit for Germany and readiness to work on-site in Munich

Nice to have

  • Early engineer at a start-up that scaled successfully
  • Systems in regulated domains (fintech, accounting, tax, payroll, insurance)
  • Multi-country or multi-jurisdiction platforms
  • LLM evaluation, RAG or agentic workflows at production scale

What success looks like after 12 months

  • Our architecture is ready for the next country without a rewrite.
  • Engineers across product areas ship faster because of the foundations and standards you set.
  • You are the founders’ go-to partner for every major technical decision.

What you’ll get

  • A seat at the table for product and company strategy
  • A senior IC path: grow towards Principal – or into engineering leadership, your choice
  • The perfect environment to build relevant skills in a world of AI
  • Above-market compensation + an equity package with real upside

The process (fast, meaningful, no homework)

  • Intro call with a recruiter
  • Technical deep-dive with a fellow engineer: walk us through a system you designed (virtually or in person)
  • Meet our founding team in a final interview (in person, ~3h, incl. system design and live coding)

Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer.

Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon.

Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt.

Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst.

Was du mitbringen musst

title: Spezialist Werkstofftechnik & Prozessentwicklung (m/w/d)
description:
Über Remloy

Seltene Erden sind unverzichtbar für zahlreiche Zukunftstechnologien – von Elektromobilität und Windkraft bis hin zu Robotik und industriellen Anwendungen. Mit innovativen Recyclingtechnologien tragen wir dazu bei, wertvolle Rohstoffe zurückzugewinnen, natürliche Ressourcen zu schonen und unabhängige, nachhaltige Lieferketten aufzubauen.

Die Remloy GmbH ist Teil der internationalen Mkango-Gruppe und spezialisiert auf das Recycling von Seltene-Erden-Permanentmagneten sowie die Herstellung hochwertiger Neodym-Eisen-Bor-Legierungspulver (NdFeB). An unserem Standort in Bitterfeld-Wolfen betreiben wir eine moderne Produktionsanlage und arbeiten daran, unsere Technologien und Produktionskapazitäten weiter auszubauen. Für den weiteren Aufbau unseres Unternehmens suchen wir einen engagierten Spezialisten Werkstofftechnik & Prozessentwicklung (m/w/d), der unsere metallurgischen Produktionsprozesse und Anlagen aktiv weiterentwickelt und als technische rechte Hand eng mit dem Produktionsleiter und dem Produktionsteam zusammenarbeitet. Im Mittelpunkt steht das Zusammenspiel von Werkstoffeigenschaften, Prozessparametern und Anlagentechnik – mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und direktem Bezug zur industriellen Praxis.

Das können Sie bewegen:

  • Werkstoff- & Prozessentwicklung: Analyse und Optimierung metallurgischer Produktions- und Schmelzprozesse sowie Weiterentwicklung der Verarbeitung von NdFeB-Legierungen. Untersuchung, wie Prozessbedingungen das Verhalten und die Eigenschaften metallischer Werkstoffe beeinflussen.
  • Materialqualität & Produktionsoptimierung: Analyse der Einflussgrößen auf Materialeigenschaften, Produktqualität und Materialausbeute sowie Ermittlung der Ursachen von Qualitätsabweichungen und Prozessabweichungen. Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen für höhere Reproduzierbarkeit, Effizienz und Prozesssicherheit.
  • Technische Anlagenoptimierung: Analyse des Zusammenspiels von Material, Prozess und Produktionsanlage, Identifikation technischer Schwachstellen und Entwicklung geeigneter Anlagenmodifikationen. Praktische Umsetzung und Bewertung gemeinsam mit dem Produktionsteam zur Verbesserung von Anlagenleistung, Verfügbarkeit, Ergonomie und technischer Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Versuchsplanung & Datenanalyse: Eigenständige Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung systematischer Produktionsversuche. Analyse von Prozessparametern, Materialeigenschaften und Qualitätsdaten, Umsetzung datenbasierter Verbesserungen sowie Weiterentwicklung von Prozessüberwachung und Datenerfassung.
  • Technische Weiterentwicklung: Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Vakuumtechnik, Schmelzanlagen, Sensorik und Steuerungssystemen. Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produktionsverfahren und Anlagenkomponenten sowie Bewertung und praktische Erprobung neuer technischer Ansätze.
  • Anlagenbetreuung & Produktionsunterstützung: Unterstützung bei technischen Fehleranalysen, Wartungsplanung und Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktionsleiter und dem Produktionsteam.
  • Eigenverantwortliche Projektarbeit: Betreuung technischer Entwicklungs- und Optimierungsprojekte von der Problemanalyse über die Lösungsentwicklung bis zur aktiven Begleitung der Umsetzung im Produktionsumfeld.

Das bringen Sie mit:

Grundlegende Anforderungen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Materialwissenschaften, Werkstofftechnik, Metallurgie oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Fachrichtung.
  • Fundiertes Verständnis metallischer Werkstoffe, ihrer Eigenschaften und ihres Verhaltens unter unterschiedlichen thermischen und verfahrenstechnischen Bedingungen sowie Kenntnisse ihrer Verarbeitung, insbesondere thermischer und metallurgischer Verfahren.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, um Zusammenhänge zwischen Materialeigenschaften, Prozessparametern und Produktqualität zu untersuchen und wissenschaftlich-technische Erkenntnisse in konkrete industrielle Verbesserungsmaßnahmen zu übertragen.
  • Interesse an industriellen Produktionsanlagen, Bereitschaft zur aktiven Mitarbeit im Produktionsumfeld und Fähigkeit zur Einarbeitung in komplexe Prozesse. Bewerber aus anwendungsnaher Forschung und Entwicklung mit ausgeprägtem Umsetzungsinteresse sind ebenfalls willkommen.
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Sie verstehen technische Probleme, entwickeln geeignete Lösungen und begleiten deren Umsetzung aktiv.

Wünschenswerte Zusatzqualifikationen:

  • Erfahrung mit Permanentmagneten, insbesondere NdFeB, Kenntnisse über Seltene Erden, deren Legierungen und metallurgische Eigenschaften sowie Praxis mit Vakuumschmelzanlagen oder anderen industriellen Schmelzverfahren.
  • Kenntnisse in Sensorik, Mess- und Regeltechnik, Automatisierung und Steuerungssystemen (z. B. SPS), industrieller Datenerfassung, IoT und Datenanalyse sowie Erfahrung mit statistischer Versuchsplanung (DoE), Six Sigma oder DMAIC.
  • Grundkenntnisse in CAD-Konstruktion und technischer Zeichnungserstellung sowie Erfahrung mit Wartungsplanung, technischer Instandhaltung oder Ersatzteilmanagement.

Darauf können Sie sich bei Remloy freuen:

  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket – wettbewerbsfähiges Grundgehalt, Bonusmöglichkeiten und Unterstützung bei der privaten Altersvorsorge.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung – hohe zeitliche Eigenverantwortung und ergebnisorientiertes Arbeiten.
  • Mobiles Arbeiten - Homeoffice möglich in Abstimmung .
  • 30 Tage Urlaub – für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung – eigenständige Aufgaben, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung.
  • Innovatives und internationales Umfeld – abwechslungsreiche und unternehmensübergreifende Aufgaben innerhalb einer wachsenden internationalen Unternehmensgruppe.

title: People Partner, Germany
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our People Operations Team

Help shape how we support and grow our teams in Germany. As our People Partner, Germany, you’ll combine deep local expertise with the opportunity to build and improve the People foundations of a fast-changing business. Reporting to Josh Gladwin, you’ll strategically partner with Fleet Operations Germany and be a visible, trusted point of contact for employees and managers across the country. You’ll work closely with our global People Partner team and local leaders to turn compliance requirements into practical processes while building a strong employee experience.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

Audit and strengthen German People policies, processes and regulatory compliance, owning improvements through implementation.

Manage employee relations cases end to end, including probations, grievances and exits.

Partner with Fleet Operations leaders and provide responsive local guidance to employees and managers across Germany.

Collaborate with departmental People Partners to deliver consistent global practices that meet local requirements.

Build trusted relationships with local leadership, communicate clearly and contribute to a visible, people-oriented culture.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

Auditing German People processes, identifying compliance gaps and project-managing improvements from recommendation through rollout, including policies, regulatory reporting, health checks and exit processes.

Owning employee relations cases end to end, including probations, probation exits, grievances and other exits, working with works councils.

Acting as the visible first point of contact for employees and managers across Germany, including local benefits, time off and day-to-day guidance.

Strategically partnering with Fleet Operations Germany and operational stakeholders.

Working with departmental People Partners on employee relations and process rollouts, and influencing leaders through clear individual and group communications.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Deep practical expertise in Germany’s employment, regulatory and People compliance landscape.

End-to-end employee relations experience, including exits, probations and grievances, plus experience working with a works council.

A track record of independently building or improving People processes in a fast-paced, changing organisation.

Experience partnering with operational stakeholders and influencing leaders.

Fluent written and spoken German, with English sufficient for effective collaboration with global colleagues.

An approachable, visible partnering style and the ability to attend the office 2–3 days per week, ideally 3.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency interview with the hiring manager

  • Deep-dive interviews: an in-person office interview and a presentation / panel

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. title: Forward-Deployed Engineer
description:
ZeitMind, the autonomous data engineer for the European mid-market

About Zeit AI
In the coming years, AI agents will take over the work of internal data teams. We’re building the one companies will use. ZeitMind connects to the systems companies already run (ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, internal databases), cleans messy data, runs analyses on its own and builds data applications. Every employee can work with data in plain language, with no technical degree and no help from IT.

Our customers use it to organise agricultural inventories, to schedule maintenance, crews and flights for jet operators, and to replace controllers’ manual Excel reports.

Founded by Marvin and Leopold, both ex-Palantir. YC S24, backed by Oxford Seed Fund and Sequoia Scout. Zero to €1M ARR in our first twelve months with six people.

Your mission
Forward Deployed Engineers find where real value is hidden in a company’s data and build the apps that unlock it. Half business, half tech: you’re as comfortable in front of a CEO as inside a dataset.

What you’ll do

  • Spend real time at customer sites, from the CFO’s office to the warehouse floor, and get to the core of an unfamiliar business fast

  • Decide what’s worth building, and just as importantly, what isn’t

  • Use ZeitMind to connect customer data, model business logic (margins, costs, stock, pricing) and ship operational apps within days

  • Present to managing directors and owners, and take them from “interesting demo” to “we run on this every day”

  • Own a portfolio of customers end to end, and shape our product and how we deploy it

What we value

  • You learn fast. New industry, new data, new terms: you get up to speed in no time.

  • You bring structure. You break messy problems into clear parts and know where to start.

  • You care about outcomes. You go after the root cause and the euro value, not the nice-looking analysis.

  • You’re rigorous. You can explain exactly how a number came about.

  • You make things happen. You don’t wait for a perfect brief. You take ownership and move.

We hire across levels, from exceptional early-career talent to senior FDEs who’ve led complex client engagements.

Backgrounds that fit well (none of these is a must)

  • Consulting. You’ve led client work across industries and know how to win over a managing director.

  • Software implementation or value engineering. You’ve rolled out software at customers and made sure it actually got used.

  • Data analytics, BI or controlling. You’ve worked hands-on with real company data.

  • Technical foundation. You’ve studied something quantitative or picked up SQL along the way, and you like knowing how things work under the hood.

You don’t need to be a software engineer, but you should have a natural pull towards data and technology. ZeitMind does the heavy lifting.

The basics

  • English at C1 or above. German is a big plus, since many of our customers work in German.

  • You’re excited to work in-person in Munich or London and at customer sites, at an early-stage startup pace.

What we offer

  • Real ownership from day one, full trust and maximum support

  • Best tools, zero blockers

  • Daily lunch allowance, dinner covered in the office, Wellpass

  • Regular team offsites

  • Relocation support within Europe

  • €5k referral bonus if we hire someone you refer

Interview process

  2. Decomposition interview

  3. ZeitMind take-home case

  4. Founder conversation with Leopold and lunch with the team

  5. References → offer

We aim to get through this in two weeks.

title: Customer Success Manager, SME & Growth, DACH
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll shape how SME customers in DACH realise lasting value from Airwallex by building clear, scalable customer journeys from handover and onboarding through activation, adoption, retention and expansion readiness.

  • Build clear, scalable customer journeys across handover, onboarding, first value, adoption, retention, reactivation and expansion readiness.

  • Create segmented, cohort-based and trigger-led lifecycle programmes using customer context and product signals.

  • Develop customer education and enablement experiences, including onboarding materials, webinars, enablement sessions, campaign content, FAQs and self-service resources.

  • Establish repeatable playbooks, journey standards, handover requirements, engagement triggers and internal workflows that create a consistent customer experience.

  • Use customer insight, product signals and operational data to identify friction, define success measures and continuously improve lifecycle programmes.

  • Partner with Account Management, Sales, Product, Risk, FinOps, Support, Operations and RevOps to improve customer outcomes and contribute to the operating model, dashboards, tooling requirements and ways of working for a growing DACH Customer Success function.

You'll work from our Berlin office three days a week.


What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Lifecycle Management, Customer Enablement, Customer Operations, Onboarding, Learning & Development or a comparable customer-facing or operational role.

  • Experience designing and improving customer journeys, lifecycle programmes, enablement initiatives, operational processes or playbooks.

  • Ability to turn customer insight and data into clear priorities, practical improvements and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong written communication and content skills, with the ability to make complex products or processes straightforward for different audiences.

  • Strong analytical and operational skills, including experience defining success measures and using CRM, analytics or campaign tools to monitor results.

  • Ability to work across functions, clarify ownership and drive programmes from idea through implementation and iteration.

  • Confidence engaging with customers and internal stakeholders, including in workshops, onboarding or enablement sessions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.

  • A structured, pragmatic approach and the ability to balance detail with progress in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, payments, SaaS, financial services or another technical product environment.

  • Experience with lifecycle marketing or customer engagement platforms, customer education, scaled success programmes or digital adoption.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Looker, Zendesk, Google Workspace, SQL or similar CRM, analytics and support tools.

  • Experience working with KYC/KYB, risk, compliance, payment operations or other regulated financial workflows.

  • Experience in a high-growth environment where processes, ownership and operating models are still being built.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Equal opportunity

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling.

As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.

This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow "AI seller" title.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.
  • Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.
  • Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.
  • Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.
  • Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.
  • Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.
  • Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.
  • Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.
  • Travel within the assigned territory as required. 

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.
  • Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.
  • Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.
  • Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software.
  • Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills.
  • Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.
  • Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills.
  • B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field.
  • Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.


We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.


We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the product surfaces that housing providers, contractors, and residents use every day. This is a fully remote position; we currently have remote engineers based in the UK, Germany, Turkey, Poland, Italy, Spain, and Portugal. You will report to a Team Lead, a hands-on engineer who still writes code and has a small number of engineers reporting to them, and work alongside product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data analysts.


Our frontend is built on TypeScript, React, React Router, TanStack Query, MaterialUI and BaseUI, against an increasingly service-oriented backend built in Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. The codebase is large but clean, because we put real weight on design patterns, readability, testability, maintainability, and extendability.


The engineering team sits at the centre of what Plentific does, and the problems are genuinely difficult: online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Much of it is high-volume and messy legacy integrations, complex permissions, strict compliance requirements, and users who need software to fit how work actually happens on the ground. We expect you to apply engineering judgement to these problems rather than only writing the code in front of you, and to treat agentic, spec-driven development as a normal part of how you work rather than an experiment.


Success in this role means shipping interfaces that are fast, accessible, and well-tested, raising the standard of the frontend codebase around you, and leaving the engineers you work with better than you found them.

Key Responsibilities

Frontend Engineering

  • Build and maintain product interfaces in TypeScript, React, TanStack Query, React Router, MaterialUI and BaseUI across our web applications.

  • Translate product requirements and design concepts into technical documents that set out scope, system behaviour, edge cases, and high-level technical analysis.

  • Design component APIs, state management, and data-fetching patterns that stay readable and extendable as the codebase grows.

  • Integrate against REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, shaping the contracts with backend engineers rather than accepting whatever is offered.

  • Review, refactor, and retire existing code so it meets the requirements of improved or new features.

  • Review and improve our development workflows, continuous integration checks, deployment pipelines and infrastructure.

  • Keep up to date with technology and bring in new standards and practices for improved user or developer experience

Performance, Quality, and Reliability

  • Diagnose and resolve page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems.

  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that give the team confidence to ship frequently.

  • Instrument frontend observability with tools such as Sentry, Grafana Logs or New Relic, and act on what they show.

  • Debug and fix production issues across our applications, including the integration points where frontend and backend behaviour diverge.

  • Design against common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF.

Agentic and Spec-Driven Development

  • Turn ambiguous product ideas into implementation-ready specs, including user flows, component behaviour, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and test expectations.

  • Prototype interfaces and interaction quickly, using working software to test feasibility and product value before committing to larger delivery.

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to generate, refactor, test, and review code within clear technical constraints.

  • Evaluate AI-generated code critically for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, accessibility, and fit with Plentific's architecture.

  • Improve the team's spec-driven development practice through reusable prompt patterns, review checklists, examples, and lightweight documentation.

Collaboration and Craft

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and backend engineers from problem framing through release, applying engineering judgement to improve the user experience before implementation starts.

  • Collaborate with other engineers through code review and pair programming.

  • Define and communicate frontend standards and best practices, and hold the team to them in review.

  • Write concise technical documentation covering components, algorithms, APIs, and operational handover.

  • Articulate technical trade-offs in plain English to technical and non-technical colleagues, including when scope, quality, or delivery timing needs to change.

Requirements

  • Expert-level TypeScript and modern JavaScript, with deep command of React and the patterns around it, including data fetching, routing, and component libraries.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, testing, debugging, and code that stays readable and extendable at scale.

  • Sound grasp of UI, UX and accessibility considerations, with the judgement to improve a design before building it rather than implement it exactly as drawn.

  • Demonstrable experience diagnosing and fixing page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems.

  • Working knowledge of frontend observability with Sentry, Grafana logs, or New Relic, and of CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions or ArgoCD.

  • Working knowledge of frontend observability with Sentry, Grafana logs, New Relic or other tools used to monitor, diagnose and fix issues

  • Hands-on background with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions or ArgoCD) as well as modern frontend architecture patterns.

  • Practical awareness of common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF, and how to design against them.

  • Strong working fluency with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development workflows, including specification writing, code generation, test generation, and critical review.

  • Clear communication, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and trade-offs in plain English.

  • High ambition and a strong sense of urgency, with the drive to deliver an ambitious product roadmap at pace using AI, and a positive, can-do attitude.Experience and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years of commercial React and TypeScript.

  • Experience shipping and operating production frontends for customer-facing SaaS products, including monitoring, incident response, and performance improvement.

  • Experience working in a large, long-lived codebase where design patterns, testability, and maintainability genuinely matter.

  • Experience consuming and shaping REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, ideally backed by Django REST Framework or an equivalent.

  • Experience working in cross-functional teams with product managers and designers on shared customer outcomes, not only technical delivery.

  • Experience using AI coding tools in a professional software delivery workflow, ideally within a spec-driven development framework.

Benefits

We offer:

  • A salary package aligned to the role and market

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Fully remote working, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

title: Product Marketing Manager, Energy & Defence
description:
Finance Deserves Better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, project or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée. Now we’re taking Light into specific industries, with the ambition of becoming the operating layer each one runs on. Energy and defence sit among our priority sectors.

The Role

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to go deep on energy and defence and work out how Light wins there.

Energy developers, operators and service businesses share a lot with defence technology and service suppliers. Both run on project and contract economics, both report across several entities, and both face long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles where auditability and approvals carry real weight. Your job is to understand these buyers better than anyone at Light, turn what you learn into positioning and proof our sales team can use, and build the playbook we follow to scale our go-to-market across both sectors.

You’ll sit in our product marketing team and work side by side with the Sales Managers who cover these sectors, with support from demand generation, field marketing and product.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Interviewing customers, prospects and specialist partners to learn how energy and defence businesses buy, what makes them change and where their finance workflows break.

  • Mapping the market with Sales: which segments we go after first, which we test, and which we leave for later.

  • Turning what you learn into positioning, messaging and competitive arguments that hold up in front of a project director or a CFO.

  • Building the sales kit, from customer stories and demo narratives to objection handling and one-pagers, so our reps speak each sector’s language.

  • Training sales reps and SDRs on the buyers, procurement cycles, contract structures and regulatory context of each segment, and joining customer calls to hear what lands.

  • Bringing the sectors’ requirements back to Product, from project and contract economics to cash visibility, evidence trails and integrations with operational systems, and separating the needs that recur from the one-off requests.

  • Giving demand generation and field marketing the insight, content and angles they need for sector campaigns and events, and tracking what turns into pipeline.

  • Writing down what works, so the next sector we enter starts from a playbook rather than a blank page.

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Product marketing experience at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of taking a product or segment from insight to launch to sales adoption.

  • A habit of talking to customers, and the judgement to turn interviews into clear positioning.

  • Experience in energy, defence, infrastructure, industrials or another complex B2B sector helps. Curiosity and the speed to earn credibility with technical buyers matter more.

  • Strong writing, from a sharp one-pager to a customer story people want to share.

  • Comfort working with Sales every day, and a feel for what helps a rep win a long, complex deal.

  • An analytical streak. You can read funnel data, spot where deals stall and test why.

  • Daily use of AI for research, writing and analysis, with the discipline to check what it tells you.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

The Good Stuff

🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London.
💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🌍 Travel to Copenhagen, Munich, New York, Paris and wherever energy and defence customers, partners and industry events take us.
🚀 The chance to define how Light wins in two sectors from their first deals.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

Energy and defence businesses manage complex projects, contracts and entities on finance tools that weren’t built for them. We want to change that, and we want you to learn both sectors inside out and show us how. When you apply, tell us about a segment you got to know from scratch: how you learned it, what you changed because of it, and how you helped Sales win there.

title: Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI (EU/UK)
description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI (EU/UK) to join our dynamic and collaborative Legal team. In this pivotal role, you will provide practical and strategic legal guidance for our UK and European businesses on matters related to privacy, AI, and data protection. You will be instrumental in developing and scaling our privacy and AI programs across the region as we continue to innovate at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and consumer products. Reporting to our Head Counsel, Privacy & AI, you will lead a small team and work closely with our Data Protection Officer and our global Privacy & AI Legal team.

You’ll work cross-functionally with teams in product, marketing, engineering, security, and compliance, as well as clinical teams, to ensure our data practices and digital health offerings align with evolving UK and EU legal frameworks and privacy expectations. This is a fantastic opportunity for a lawyer who thrives in a mission-driven, fast-paced environment and is excited to help shape the future of consumer healthcare. This is a remote role open to candidates based in the UK or EU.

You Will:

  • Serve as the lead legal advisor and subject matter expert on UK and EU privacy and AI law and apply your expertise across all business functions in the region.

  • Monitor UK and EU legal and regulatory developments in privacy and AI matters and translate them into clear, business-friendly guidance.

  • Lead incident response for privacy and AI-related matters in the region, collaborating with cross-functional partners and our Data Protection Officer from the detection stage to mitigation.

  • Lead engagement with the ICO and EU supervisory authorities, and handle complex data subject requests and third-party and law enforcement disclosure requests.

  • Negotiate DPAs, data sharing agreements, and AI terms with vendors and partners, and manage outside counsel in the region.

You Have:

  • Deep expertise in the UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and PECR and EU ePrivacy rules, including for special category health data, and working knowledge of consumer protection regulations, the EU AI Act, and healthcare privacy frameworks

  • A strong track record of building cross-functional relationships across AI, Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to provide strategic and practical counsel.
