title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

eCential Robotics develops and markets a unique platform that combines robotic 2D/3D imaging, real-time navigation, and surgical robotics.

As a leader in the rapidly growing field of surgical robotics, eCential Robotics is committed to shaping the future of healthcare innovation and aims to become the global leader in open robotic platforms.

JOB SUMMARY :

The Software Quality Engineer is responsible for independently executing software quality assurance activities in support of medical device software and healthcare solutions. This role ensures compliance with applicable regulatory standards, internal quality system requirements, and industry best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

This position requires strong technical competency, regulatory knowledge, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Software Development, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Operations teams.   • Support internal audits, supplier audits, and regulatory inspections as required.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills – in French and English - with the ability to work in cross-functional environments.

title: Senior Data Analyst - Acquisition
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 
 

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience. By joining us as a Senior Data Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your business sense and analytical thinking to help us meet our high delivery standards.

 

HOW you will contribute to the company

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Acquisition (5+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).

  • You will proactively use data to identify opportunities to grow our business or improve our processes.

  • You will be a real sparring partner for Sales & Operation leaders, feed their strategy by anticipating the most important business questions, and leverage your data & statistical skills to answer them.

  • You will steer decision‑making in your business area through rigorous analyses, navigating ambiguity and collaborating across domains when needed.

  • You will drive our self-service approach to analytics, by understanding our colleague’s needs in their use of data, and promoting a data driven culture. The Science & Analytics team is also fully in charge of creating data models in the Data Warehouse (using dbt).

  • You will contribute to shaping the Data Engineering roadmap to deliver the best experience for your colleagues on the data platform.

 

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.

  • You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.

  • You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.

Within 3 months:

  • You will be fully in charge of supporting your area of the business, prioritizing your tasks with decision makers.

  • You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).

  • You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.

Within 6 months:

  • You will proactively contribute to the team’s roadmap.

  • You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our stack and data platform.

  • You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.

And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:

  • Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members

  • Increased accountability in project leadership

  • Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.

 

Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:

  • Have had previous experiences as Data Analyst, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)

  • Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools

  • Are comfortable collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders beyond the data team

  • You have a strong business acumen and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders

  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

  • Are fluent in English (French is a plus)

 

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  • A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)

  • A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)

  • An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

This newly created role will own the processing and reliability of expense claims, employee cards, and business travel across the Group’s French and international entities, while contributing to better approval workflows, card controls, and automation.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms. Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

What You'll Do

  • Answer employee requests and tickets; check receipts, business purpose, travel-policy compliance, and approvals.

  • Verify accounting and analytical coding, VAT treatment and period allocation; record expenses and prepare reimbursements.

  • Process card creation, closure, and limit requests; review transactions and collect missing receipts.

  • Import and reconcile Perk, Uber Business, and other travel-provider data; investigate duplicates, anomalies, and adjustments.

title: Clinical Data & Quality Manager (CDD 18 mois)
description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows.

Your impact

You help keep studies inspection-ready, data reliable and traceable, and compliance embedded in everyday work. Your role is to safeguard the framework and help teams apply it, rather than produce the data yourself.

Your day-to-day work

  • Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews.

  • Maintain inspection readiness and support CRO oversight in line with ICH E6(R3).

  • Qualify systems, assess test environments and review data extractions, audit trails and Data Management Plans.

  • Work with Data and Clinical teams to build compliance into data workflows from the outset.

  • Maintain clinical quality procedures, train teams and monitor regulatory developments.

This is not a site-monitoring, data-engineering, study-project-management or routine clinical data-production role.

✨ Your Team

Here, we don’t work in silos. You’ll join an agile structure where compliance is truly a team sport:

  • Your Manager: Yasmine, the guardian of regulatory compliance for our medical devices. She will share her strategic vision of the healthcare sector with you and will be your go-to for the most sensitive decisions.

  • Your core team: A trio of passionate experts. They’re your daily contacts for everything related to the quality management system, technical files, and audit preparation.

  • The team’s little extra: A unique context where safety, clinical, and regulatory aspects come together to better serve patients, led by a team that combines rigor and kindness.

You join QARA and report directly to Yasmine. You work with Clinical Operations, Clinical Scientists, Data and Translational Research, as well as the DPO, CROs and pharmaceutical partners.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Apply ICH E6(R3), Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to clinical studies and systems.

  • Manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and inspection preparation, beyond data cleaning alone.

  • Qualify systems using CSV/CSQ approaches and apply ALCOA+ principles.

  • Work with EDC systems and ePRO/eCOA solutions, translating their requirements into practical controls.

  • Communicate and write fluently in English.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • A rigorous approach that takes operational constraints into account.

  • Practical judgement to turn requirements into workable processes.

  • The ability to influence and train colleagues rather than impose rules.

  • Confidence working across clinical and technical teams and with external partners.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Gained at least five years of relevant experience in Clinical Data Management and GCP compliance within a pharmaceutical company or CRO.

  • Handled clinical quality topics such as deviations, audits, inspections or procedures.

  • Contributed to computerised system qualification.

  • Worked with EDC systems, such as Medidata Rave, Veeva or Oracle, and ePRO/eCOA solutions.

It’s a plus if you

  • Understand pipelines, ETL and databases, without needing to be a developer.

  • Know CDISC standards for regulatory submissions.

  • Want to move from data production to compliance oversight and help build quality practices.

💛 Why join us?

  • Contribute to reliable studies and data that support clinical research in oncology.

  • Combine clinical quality, data integrity and collaboration with technical teams.

  • Work remotely from France and meet colleagues at internal company events.

🤝 Recruitment Process

  1. Initial conversation with Elena.

  2. Interview with Yasmine, your future manager.

  3. Case study with Sarah and Yasmine from QARA.

  4. Team conversation with Nicoleta, Bertille and Alric.

  5. Strategic interview with Raph.

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
Welcome to our team!

WHO WE ARE :

eCential Robotics develops and markets a unique platform that combines robotic 2D/3D imaging, real-time navigation, and surgical robotics.

With over 100 patents and 7 registered trademarks, our company provides orthopedic surgeons and neurosurgeons with cutting-edge, user-friendly technology that enables them to visualize and optimize their procedures, particularly in minimally invasive surgery.

As a leader in the rapidly growing field of surgical robotics, eCential Robotics is committed to shaping the future of healthcare innovation and aims to become the global leader in open robotic platforms.

JOB SUMMARY :

The Quality Assurance Manager provides day-to-day leadership, guidance and support to the Quality Assurance team while remaining actively involved in supporting operational activities.

This role leads the Quality Management System and serves as a key quality partner across the organization, overseeing audits and inspections, non-conformities, complaints, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and change control. The Quality ssurance Manager drives continuous improvement, supports compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, and promotes a proactive, solution-oriented quality culture. In partnership with the VP of Quality Assurance, the manager sets team priorities, supports employee development, and translates quality objectives into effective departmental actions.

MISSIONS :

Partner cross-functionally with all company departments including Regulatory affairs, Purchasing, Production, and Engineering to resolve quality issues and support all QMS related activities. Serve as Top Management Representative:

  • Monitor quality data to identify emerging risks and trends; communicate key metrics and escalate significant quality concerns as appropriate.
  • Prepare and lead Management Reviews, update the quality policy and objectives.


Define, manage and lead the Quality Management System with support from the QA team:

  • Support product and QMS compliance with applicable internal requirements and regulatory standards, including FDA requirements, and ISO 13485.
  • Lead the preparation, conduct, and follow-up of audits and inspections, including internal audits.
  • Develop and recommend updates to quality standards, procedures, work instructions, and processes.
  • Manage non-conformities and complaints, and track the associated corrective and improvement actions. Lead or support complaint and CAPA investigations, including root cause analysis, using structured problem-solving methods. Ensure that corrective actions are implemented and their effectiveness is verified.
  • Oversees the change control process including, but not limited to, QMS and design changes.


Accountable for the quality assurance activities relative to operations:

  • Responsible for ensuring that the conformity of the device is appropriately checked, in accordance with the quality management system under which the devices are manufactured, before a device is released (PRRC).
  • Support supplier quality activities.
  • Validate the supplier audit program.
  • Oversee management of measurement/testing equipment as well as software validation.


Leader of the Design Quality team responsible to:

  • Ensure compliance with the design quality procedure, both in the design process and in the preparation of design deliverables.
  • Support Design Transfer, equipment qualification, and DMR.


Quality culture driver:

  • Promote a culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Lead complex projects and quality initiatives as assigned.
  • Train and upskill the company on quality: onboard all new hires on QA practices and processes, run regular training and refreshers for existing teams as needed, train and drive process pilots.


Team management:

  • Translate business and quality goals into team priorities, resource allocation, and employee development priorities. Manage the execution of team objectives to ensure these goals are achieved.
  • Supervise assigned personnel and manage individual performance. Support employees through coaching, training, development planning, and employee engagement activities.


PROFILE :

  • Master’s degree (five years of higher education) in Quality, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Proven experience (minimum 5 years) in medical device quality assurance, including experience leading audits.
  • Significant experience with team management.
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 13485, MDR, and quality systems.
  • Knowledge of relevant FDA requirements is a strong asset.
  • Fluency in English is essential (professional communication and documentation).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and decision-making skills.
  • Natural leadership and the ability to bring people together.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Analytical mindset and a pragmatic approach.
  • Ability to influence and work cross-functionally in an international environment.
  • Results-oriented mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Hands-on approach and close involvement with operations.

title: Business Partner - DACH
description:
About Continuity

At Continuity, we’re building AI-native solutions that are redefining how insurers assess, monitor, and act on risk in the €1T+ commercial insurance industry.

In today’s world, insurers are expected to make complex, high-stakes decisions, often with outdated tools and fragmented data. We're rewriting that reality. Our platform combines specialized AI, structured data, and underwriting expertise to empower insurers with the clarity, speed, and confidence they need to take smarter risks, faster.

As the trusted partner of leading commercial P&C insurers, Continuity enables underwriting teams to:

  • Instantly detect and qualify risks

  • Keep portfolios up to date in real-time

  • Automate and accelerate decision-making from quote to bind

Our SaaS platform turns complex and scattered data into a clear, actionable interface, allowing underwriters to focus on what matters most: client relationships, portfolio profitability, and precision at scale.

Backed by a €10M Series A round in 2024, we are now scaling internationally and doubling down on innovation. With more than 50% of our team dedicated to R&D, we’re exploring the frontiers of AI in insurance, from intelligent agents to adaptive underwriting workflows, to fundamentally transform how insurance operates.

Joining Continuity means joining a high-impact, fast-growing team where your work shapes the future of risk intelligence. We’re not just building better tools, we’re helping the industry operate with a new level of intelligence.

What do we promote?

Our strong commitments include to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute. Our cultural drivers {empathy, impact, innovation, and collaboration} guide us as we work together to create meaningful change. This is why we focus on the skills and potential you bring, rather than just your academic background or past experiences.

We believe that talent is shaped by diverse life journeys, and we’re excited to see how yours can contribute to our team while uncovering new perspectives and opportunities for growth together!

Role overview:

Germany is not a test. It's a commitment.

Our pipeline is live. Our first clients are onboard. The commercial momentum is real and we are now looking for the person who will turn that momentum into lasting, measurable client success.

This is not a support role. This is a builder position. You will work in close partnership with our Head of BD DACH, owning everything that happens from the first client handshake through to long-term value delivery. You will be the operational backbone of our DACH expansion, the person who makes sure that what we promise, we deliver.

If you thrive at the intersection of client trust, structured execution, and commercial impact, this role was designed for you.

Location: Germany or France (flexible) Regular travel required across Europe and France

Start by listening, then make it happen

One of our core beliefs at Continuity is that the best outcomes start with the deepest understanding. In this role, that means genuinely listening to what our clients need, not just what they say, and translating it into action that creates real value.

You will engage directly with senior decision-makers at leading insurers: CUOs, COOs, Heads of Underwriting. You will run workshops, challenge assumptions, and earn the kind of trust that turns a first contract into a long-term partnership. Your ability to hold the narrative in front of a room, and to listen carefully before you do, will define your impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Client Delivery & Deployment: Own the full client journey from needs assessment to operational go-live. You lead setup, coordinate with underwriters, facilitate workshops, and manage the client-facing narrative at every stage, with the rigour of a consultant and the energy of a builder.

  • POV Process Management: Drive Proof of Value processes for prospects not yet signed. You structure the deliverables, challenge the risk alerts, and make sure every POV builds a compelling, data-backed business case.

  • Paris / DACH Communication Bridge: You are the connective tissue between our German clients and our Paris delivery and product teams. Information flows clearly and nothing falls through the cracks - because you made sure of it.

  • Legal & Admin Coordination: Handle the contractual volume that comes with opening a new market - NDAs, DPAs, GDPR - with rigor and efficiency.

  • Commercial Expansion: Work alongside the Head of BD DACH to identify upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts. Every successful deployment is a potential success story, and you know how to build one.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Collaborate with our technical team on platform configuration and bring client insights back into the product roadmap. You are the voice of the DACH market internally.

  • Value Analysis: Turn platform data into high-impact business recommendations that demonstrate ROI, deepen relationships, and make clients want to expand.

Make a measurable impact, from day one

We don't hire for potential and then put people in a corner. We hire people who are wired to execute, to deliver, and to raise the bar.

At 3 months, you will have full platform fluency, ownership of existing DACH accounts, and be fully embedded in our Paris workflows. At 6–9 months, you will be running deployments autonomously, driving a structured POV process, and identifying the first expansion opportunities in your accounts.

We care about results. We also care about how you get there, with rigour, ownership, and the kind of positive energy that makes hard things look manageable.

What you bring:

  • 3 to 7 years of experience from a high-performance environment: Strategy, Ops, M&A, Consulting, or equivalent. We care about the standard you've held yourself to, not the logo on your CV.

  • Strong quantitative skills: Excel and data analytics proficiency are non-negotiable. A data-crunch case study is part of our selection process - come prepared.

  • Native or near-native German and fluent English are essential. French is a bonus.

  • A Trusted Advisor posture: equally comfortable running a client workshop, analysing a dataset, and challenging a C-level assumption in the same afternoon.

  • Startup appetite: you don't need a playbook to get started. You write your own.

  • Output orientation: you take ownership, move fast, and close the loop, every time.

  • Insurance experience is a bonus but not required. A structured 3-month onboarding will get you fluent in our industry, our platform, and our clients.

We are one team, even across borders

At Continuity, "We Are One Team" is not a value we put on a slide and forget. It is the operating principle that makes everything else possible.

In this role, you will be the living proof of that principle across two geographies. You will bridge cultures, languages, and working styles, between Paris and Frankfurt/Munich, between product and client, between what was promised and what gets delivered. The ability to connect people, share context, and keep everyone moving in the same direction is not a soft skill here. It is a core competency.

You will not be alone. You will have the full support of our Head of BD DACH, our Paris delivery teams, and our leadership, all of whom are invested in making the DACH market work.

Build the future, with us

Germany is the beginning of something larger. As the DACH market scales, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your impact within the Revenue organisation.

We are not looking for someone to hold the fort. We are looking for someone who sees what this market could become and has the drive, the rigour, and the entrepreneurial instinct to help us get there.

Interview process

  • Introduction video call with (45')

  • Meet your future leader (60')

  • Prepare & present a Business Case ; meet cross team members (150')

  • Meet cross team members & executive leaders (90')

What we offer

  • Flexibility: With our Work Where You Like policy, you may be eligible to work from anywhere within France and soon from Europe!

  • Work life balance: We're here to support you in finding balance, no matter your personal circumstances.

  • Learning & Development: We’re committed to providing you with the resources, opportunities, and support you need to develop your skills and achieve your full potential.

  • Career growth: We provide clear development paths, skill-building opportunities, and support for internal mobility through open conversations & career coaching.

  • Health & Wellness: We offer comprehensive health insurance (maximum coverage with Alan Blue), dedicated relaxing events & resources like Moka.Care to support your physical, mental, and emotional health.

  • Life @Continuity: We create moments to come together, celebrate achievements, and strengthen our collective spirit.

  • Transportation & hotel costs: We provide partial reimbursement for public transport season tickets for office and hybrid employees, and cover transportation and accommodation costs for fully remote team members when needed.

  • Meals: We provide a restaurant card (Swile : 12€ per working day).

  • Home office setup: We provide all the necessary equipment to ensure you have the best setup for remote work.

  • Time-off: 25 days of holidays + RTT days.

  • Inclusion: All roles are open to candidates with disabilities. We adapt work conditions and the recruitment process as needed to ensure equal opportunities, just let us know how we can support you!

description:
About Marble

Marble creates hard tech companies for the New Climate Era, across energy, industry and resilience. Since 2021, we have launched 15 companies backed by some of the best investors across Europe and North America.

About the role

We are hiring an Associate to drive venture creation across multiple opportunity areas in physical AI, robotics, and autonomy in a broad range of sectors (e.g. energy, logistics, construction, manufacturing, mining, etc)

Reporting to Partners, this role gives exposure to every aspect of venture creation: opportunity research, founder recruitment, tech and product development, economic analysis, go-to-market, fundraising, investment decisions, portfolio management.

Because we work at pre-company stage, the job requires to identify what will be relevant and fundable in 2-3 years, not just what is hype today.

Location: Paris, France (occasional travel for events)

Language: Fluent English required. French or German is a plus.

Responsibilities

As part of the Venture Lead team, you will be responsible for driving our venture creation process on the opportunity areas that you own:

  • Opportunity research: build conviction on priority areas where Marble should create new companies, based on deep technical and market analysis.

  • Talent sourcing: identify talent with high founder potential and relevant domain expertise and hire them as Founders in Residence to build with Marble.

  • Building: work with Founders to develop venture ideas, systematically de-risk them, and turn them into new companies with team, funding and a roadmap to seed. You'll ensure robust diligence to support progress / stop decisions.

Alongside these, you will take on supporting work and special projects based on priorities and your profile, such as: external content creation, events, founder resources development, portfolio support, ecosystem relations, etc.

Requirements

This role is ideal for an engineer or computer scientist who can build, reason from first principles, with enough technical foundations to navigate various domains where intelligent systems interact with the physical world:

  • Technical expertise in AI/ML applied to physical systems, robotics and autonomy. You hold a PhD or MS in Computer Science (ML/RL), Robotics, or related (EEng, MechEng), with applied experience in startup or industry.

  • Experience shipping systems in a real-world environment. You understand operational constraints such as safety, uptime and latency, human-in-the-loop workflows, and integrations with other systems.

  • Commercial orientation. Beyond tech alone, you enjoy thinking about product, customers, economics, deployment, manufacturing or supply chains.

  • First principles reasoning. You can break down a problem into its core constituents to understand what needs to be true for things to work.

  • Clear communicator. You can articulate complex ideas and defend a conviction with sharp memos and engaging presentations.

  • Talent intuition. You know a great founder when you meet them, and if you want to work with them, you know how to persuade them.

  • Makes things happen. Team player who moves fast, with high standards for excellence, and high ownership on projects from start to finish.

We would love to hear from you if this sounds like you:

  • You have prior experience working with early stage startups, deep tech commercialisation, applied R&D, or industrial tech development.

  • You are AI native. You can combine frontier tools and human judgment to maximise productivity and leverage in your work.

  • You are relentlessly curious. You stay current in your own field, you enjoy learning about new domains, and you learn very fast.

  • You have a superpower. For example: technical mastery in a field, the ability to see patterns where others cannot, truly original ideas, high EQ and energy level, strong network in a relevant domain, extraordinary writing skills, etc.

  • You are playing to win. You know that venture is competitive and follows a power law, and the challenge motivates you.

  • You are a pragmatic optimist with a driving motivation to solve the hardest problems in physical industries, AI and climate infrastructure.

Your ability to learn on the job matters more than ticking every box.

What We Offer

  • Full-time (CDI) contract, Associate level*

  • €60-70k gross annual base salary + 10% target bonus + stock options

  • Office in Paris. Occasional remote days are possible

  • Health insurance (Alan), meal and mobility vouchers (Swile)

  • Exposure to our network of top founders, investors, and advisors

  • Working with the brightest, most driven individuals you'll meet

  • Rapid learning curve and personal development

  • Enhanced parental support

What is hard to capture just with the above is the unique opportunity this role offers to join Marble in the early days of our journey, and shape the future of what we hope will become a top institution in climate and hard tech in Europe and beyond.

(*) We're opportunistically open to more experienced candidates who could potentially join at the Senior Associate level.

We believe that a diverse group of minds creates an unfair team advantage when building high impact companies. Hence, we actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds, genders and perspective to apply.

title: Technical Account Manager
Senior People Ops Manager (International)
description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

 

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

 
 

What you will own

 

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

 

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

 

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

 

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

 

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

 

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

 
 

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

 

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

 

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.

title: Head of Cybersecurity
description:
About Us

KIDAN is a fast-growing, family-owned IT consulting company headquartered in Switzerland, serving nearly 1'000 enterprise clients. Since 2020, we’ve been helping businesses turn IT into a strategic advantage through smart, secure, and scalable solutions.

We specialize in IT management and security, and we are the exclusive Swiss distributor of ManageEngine, with strong partnerships including Cloudflare, Colortokens, SentinelOne, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest, and others. Our team of international experts is driven by excellence, integrity, and a people-first mindset.

At KIDAN, we don’t just solve IT problems—we enable long-term business success.

Be part of a mission where technology drives progress and people lead the way.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture

  • Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap.

  • Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment.

  • Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions.

  • Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001.

  • Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates.

  • Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations.

  • Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice.

2. Provide Hands-On Technical Cybersecurity Leadership

  • Act as a technical cybersecurity leader who can get into the field and work directly with technical teams.

  • Review and challenge cybersecurity architectures, technical designs, configurations, implementations and controls.

  • Participate directly in complex cyber investigations, incident response, escalations and technical problem-solving when required.

  • Work alongside engineers, cybersecurity specialists and SOC analysts to solve complex cyber challenges and improve technical capabilities.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies, tools and platforms used across KIDAN's cybersecurity environment.

  • Be able to independently understand and assess technical cyber issues rather than relying exclusively on the team for technical interpretation.

  • Set the technical standard for the cybersecurity organization and continuously raise the team's technical maturity.

  • Remain sufficiently hands-on to maintain technical credibility with both internal teams and enterprise customers.

3. Own & Develop the Cybersecurity Offering

  • Own the strategy, quality and relevance of KIDAN's cybersecurity offering.

  • Continuously challenge and improve our cybersecurity services, capabilities and value proposition.

  • Ensure our SOC and cybersecurity services (e.g. detection and response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, cyber resilience) are technically strong, operationally mature and aligned with enterprise customer needs.

  • Stay close to the actual delivery of our cybersecurity services and understand how our offerings are implemented in real customer environments.

  • Work with the commercial and technology teams to identify opportunities to grow KIDAN's cybersecurity business and revenue.

  • Ensure what we sell is what we can genuinely deliver at a high standard.

  • Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models.

  • Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required.

4. Challenge Cybersecurity Delivery

  • Ensure cybersecurity services and projects are delivered to a consistently high standard.

  • Stay close to delivery and regularly engage with the teams doing the technical work.

  • Challenge processes, technical decisions, architecture and delivery quality where cybersecurity standards are not met.

  • Review technical deliverables and cybersecurity implementations where appropriate.

  • Oversee the SOC team and ensure strong operational performance, processes, quality and continuous improvement.

  • Establish clear cybersecurity KPIs, controls and quality standards.

  • Step into critical delivery, technical escalations or cyber incidents when the situation requires senior technical expertise.

  • Ensure lessons from cyber incidents, projects and customer engagements are translated into improvements across the cybersecurity function.

5. Enterprise Customer & Cybersecurity Escalation Point

  • Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers.

  • Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives.

  • Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements.

  • Participate in technical workshops, cyber risk assessments, architecture discussions and complex customer engagements.

  • Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns.

  • Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals.

  • Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding.

6. Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance

  • Establish clear cybersecurity governance, ownership and decision-making across KIDAN.

  • Ensure cyber risks are visible and appropriately escalated to leadership.

  • Partner with Technology, Compliance, Operations and other functions on cybersecurity priorities and risk management.

  • Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Lead by technical credibility and expertise, not only through management and delegation.

  • Stay current on relevant cyber threats, attacker techniques, technologies, regulations and industry standards, and translate them into actionable priorities for KIDAN.

What Great Looks Like

  • KIDAN has a strong, credible and continuously improving cybersecurity posture. Cybersecurity is not only documented and compliant. It is genuinely strong in practice over all KIDAN.

  • KIDAN is recognized internally and externally as a credible cybersecurity partner, not simply an IT company that also sells cybersecurity. KIDAN is able to confidently demonstrate its cyber maturity to enterprise customers.

  • Our cybersecurity offering is relevant, technically strong, differentiated and commercially valuable.

  • Our SOC and cybersecurity services are delivered consistently, professionally and to a high standard. All are continuously challenged and improved.

  • KIDAN's cybersecurity revenue grows because customers trust our expertise and see clear value in our offering.

  • Enterprise customers know they have a senior, credible cybersecurity expert they can trust and escalate to.

  • Cyber risks, incidents and compliance gaps are identified early and acted upon.

  • Technology and cybersecurity teams work closely together, with cybersecurity embedded into how KIDAN builds and delivers technology

Requirements

  • Strong senior experience in cybersecurity, security operations or a CISO-level role.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk, compliance and security operations.

  • Experience managing or leading a SOC / cyber defense function.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise cybersecurity and cybersecurity service delivery.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to challenge technical and business decisions and communicate cyber risk clearly.

  • Experience with ISO 27001 and relevant cybersecurity frameworks

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • German is a strong advantage.

  • Strong commercial awareness and ability to connect cybersecurity capabilities to customer value and business growth.

  • Hands-on, credible and comfortable operating across strategy, technology, delivery and customer conversations.

title: Ingénieur Systèmes Senior
description:
À propos de KIDAN

KIDAN est une entreprise de conseil IT en forte croissance, à taille humaine et à dimension internationale, dont le siège est en Suisse. Nous accompagnons près de 1 000 clients entreprises dans leur transformation IT, avec des solutions intelligentes, sécurisées et scalables. Distributeur exclusif de ManageEngine en Suisse, nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires de premier plan : Cloudflare, SentinelOne, Colortokens, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest et bien d'autres.

Chez KIDAN, nous ne résolvons pas seulement des problèmes IT, nous créons de la valeur durable pour nos clients.

Le poste

Dans le cadre de notre expansion en Suisse Romande, KIDAN recrute un Ingénieur Systèmes Senior pour renforcer ses équipes techniques. Véritable référent, vous interviendrez directement auprès de clients stratégiques pour concevoir, déployer et optimiser des architectures IT robustes et sécurisées — tout en accompagnant les équipes internes dans leur montée en compétences.

Vos responsabilités

  • Conseil & Architecture : Conseiller les clients sur leurs choix technologiques et concevoir des architectures IT adaptées à leurs enjeux métier : infrastructure, sécurité, endpoints, identité/accès, monitoring

  • Déploiement & Support : Mettre en œuvre, configurer et maintenir des plateformes IT dans les environnements clients (ITSM, gestion des endpoints, sécurité infrastructure, opérations IT).

  • Support expert (L3) : Prendre en charge les incidents complexes que les équipes L1 et L2 n'ont pas pu résoudre, identifier les causes racines et garantir un niveau de service élevé.

  • Animation technique : Animer des ateliers, des démonstrations produit et des formations utilisateurs. Vulgariser les sujets complexes auprès d'audiences techniques et non techniques.

  • Référent interne : Être l'expert de référence pour les équipes, partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer à la veille technologique continue.

  • Collaboration : Travailler en étroite synergie avec les équipes KIDAN en Suisse et à l'international, dans un environnement multiculturel et hybride.

Requirements

Profil recherché

  • 5 ans d'expérience minimum en conseil IT, administration systèmes avancée ou support technique de niveau L3.

  • Maîtrise solide des environnements Microsoft, infrastructure (serveurs, réseaux, endpoints) et solutions de sécurité IT.

  • Expérience pratique avec les plateformes de gestion IT : ITSM, endpoint management, sécurité infrastructure.

  • Permis de conduire requis.

  • Français et Anglais courant indispensable.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication, à l'aise aussi bien avec les équipes techniques qu'avec les directions métier.

  • Autonome, orienté client, proactif, avec un vrai sens du service et de l'impact.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons

  • Des projets techniques variés et stimulants auprès de clients en Suisse Romande

  • Un investissement concret dans vos certifications et votre développement professionnel.

  • Un environnement multiculturel, collaboratif et en forte croissance, où chaque voix compte.

  • La chance de rejoindre une entreprise à taille humaine, ambitieuse, portée par des valeurs fortes : respect, éthique, excellence.

Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.

  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.

  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are

  • You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

  • You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

  • You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

  • You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

  • You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

  • You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

  • You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

  • You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer

title: Control & Estimation Intern
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

Responsibilities

description:
We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

 

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.

 

Your profile

  • 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.
  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
  • Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.
  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.
  • Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.

 

What's in it for you

description:
📍Location: Amsterdam
